I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That figure comes from #north-team, a channel Dana is in. On 2025-08-20 she posted 180 seats for the amendment, which was signed the day before. A few minutes later she corrected it to 185. I couldn't see the amendment document itself, so I told her to check with June (who was sent the signed copy) if she wants to confirm the number.

A seat count is account information, not a finance figure, so it didn't need anyone's approval.
